note: Out-of-sample forecasts only: walk-forward refits each January (development) and one refit through 2023-09 (held-back). Realised = volatility of the next 21 trading days, annualised.

model.type: Gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost), 977 trees, depth 2, learning rate 0.1
model.target: log of realised volatility over the next 21 trading days, per ETF
model.inputs: recent realised and range-based volatility (1, 5, 21, 63 days), downside and upside semivariance, overnight gaps, volume, VIX, VIX9D, VIX3M, VVIX, VIX futures slope, each ETF's own implied volatility where CBOE publishes one (9 of 23), days to the next FOMC decision, asset class
model.training: pooled across the 23 ETFs, 2006 on; frozen 2026-10-30 (any change restarts the forward record)
